The sunken bell legend most likely began in fishing communities before it spread to inland parishes.
The new coastal railway was the main route by which the legend traveled from the coast to inland areas.

Text 1

They found roughly half as many in aged mice as in young ones. Because B cells drive germinal-center formation, the team concluded that B cells lose this capacity with age.

Text 2

Imaging at lower resolution probably overstated how few germinal centers the aged mice actually had.

items.stem: Based on the texts, both authors would most likely agree with which statement?

The city recordings overstate how much higher urban songs are than forest songs.

City blackbirds sing more loudly because raising their pitch increases their volume.
